title: VibeCode Arcade package manifest (arcade.json)
description: The structural contract for arcade.json. src/framework/rules.ts is authoritative and also checks what a schema cannot, such as whether declared build files exist.

slug.description: Lowercase words joined by single hyphens, e.g. star-garden.

license.description: An SPDX id from the accepted free, open-source list.

prompt.description: A short paragraph on how the game was vibecoded: at least 80 characters once trimmed.

sourceUrl.description: An http(s) link to the game's source code.

builds.description: At least one build, keyed by platform. Each value is a file path relative to the package root.

web.description: Entry HTML file inside web/, e.g. web/index.html.

remixOf.description: null for an original game, or the slug of the game this one remixes.

buildPath.description: A plain relative path inside the package: no absolute paths, drive letters, UNC shares, URLs, backslashes, colons, empty segments, or dot-only segments such as ..
